title: פְעֵם
content:
[Str2942,2940,2941] פְעֵם:30 n.m.:Ezr 4:21 taste, judgement, command (BH טַ֫עַס (late sense));—abs. ´ט: Dn 3:10 +, cstr. ´ט: 5:2, Ezr 6:14, טַ֫עַס (of God, mere scribal distinction NöLCB 1896, 305 Str:§ 8 c KAramaismen 40) Ezr 6:14, 7:23; emph. טַעְמָא 4:21;—† 1. Dn 5:2 in the taste of the wine (while they were enjoying it). † 2. judgement, discretion, in reply, ´הֲתִיב עֵטָא וּט: Dn 2:14 (Pr 26:16); in act (Pers.) על ´שִים ט: Dn 3:12, 6:14 (Pr 26:16); in act (Pers.) על´שִים ט: Dn 3:12, 6:14 shew proper deference to (עַל). † 3. report (of official), c. הלך Ezr 5:5, יהב Dn 6:3. 4. command, of God Ezr 6:14, 7:23, of king 6:14; ´שִיס ט: give command, issue decree Dn 3:10 + 3 t., Ezr 4:19, 4:21, 4:21 + 11 t.; ´בְּעֵל ט: commander Ezr 4:8, 4:9, 4:17.

[Str2953,6856] † [טְפַר] n.m. nail, claw (Targum טוּפְרָא, Syr. ܝܓܪܐ; v. BH חִםפֹּ֫רֶן, √ IV. צפר);—pl. sf. of man טִפְר֫וֺהִי Dn 4:30; of beast, טפריה (K§ 53, 2. b)) 7:19, Qr טִפְרַהּ.

title: פְּלַג
content:
[Str6385–86] † [פְּלַג] vb. divide (Targum Syr.; cf. BH (chiefly late));—Pe. pass. fs. פְּלִיגָה תֶּהֱוֵה Dn 2:41 shall be divided.

[Str6387] † פְּלַג n.[m.] half;—cstr. ´פ: Dn 7:25.

[Str6392] † פְּלֻגָּה n.f. division;—sf. פְּלֻגָּֽתְהוֺן Ezr 6:18.

title: פְּלַח
content:
[Str6399,3372,6342] † [פְּלַח] v.b. pay reverence to, serve (deity) (cf. As. palâḫu, fear, revere (and Bh יָרֵא, פָּחַד etc.); Eg. Aram. פלח worship Lzb351; Targum פְּלַח serve, Syr. ܦܠܚ; Palm. פלחא soldier);—Pe. 1. pay reverence to deity (usu. ל acc.): impf. 3 mpl. יִפְלְחין Dn 3:28, 7:14, 7:27; so Pt. act. פָּלַח 6:17, 6:21, pl. פָּֽלְחִין 3:12, 3:14, 3:18, and (acc. dei) v:17. 2. pl. cstr. as n. פָּֽלְחֵי בֵית אֱלָהָא Ezr 7:24 servants of the house of God ( + priests, Nethinim, etc.).

[Str6402] † פָּלְחָן n.[m.] service, worship;—cstr. ´פ: בֵּית אֱלָהָח Ezr 7:19.

[Str6310,6433] † פֻּם n.m.:Dn 7:8 mouth (cf. BH פֶּה; on form v. K§ 61, 2) M§ 76f.);—´פ: abs. Dn 7:8, 7:20, cstr. 4:28 +, sf. פֻּמֵּהּ (on form v. Kl. c. NöZur Gram. d. Class. Ar. 15 (1896) (expansion of biliteral √), BaZMG xii (1887), 633 f.) 7:5;—mouth of king Dn 4:28, lions 6:23, beast (in vision) 7:5, horn (ib.) v:8, v:20; mouth of pit 6:18.

[Str6447] פַּס v. פסם. below

[Str6460] † פְּסַנְטֵרִין n.[m.] a (triangular) stringed instrument (Gk. ψαλτήριον, Kraussi. 12, 99, 101; ii. 473 PrinceEB 3232 DrDn lviii, and on 3, 5);—´פ: Dn 3:7, פְּסַנְתֵּירִין v:5, v:10, v:15.

title: פסס
content:
[Str6446] פסס (√of foll.; v. BH I. פסס, [פַּס]).

[Str6447] † פַּס n.m. palm of hand;—cstr. Dn 5:5, emph. פַּסָּא v:24.

[Str6523,1270] פַּרְזֶל:19 n.m.:Dn 2:40 iron (Targum Syr.; v. BH בַּרְזֶל);—abs. Dn 2:33 (ֶ+זל-), 4:12 +; emph. פַּרְזְלָא 2:34 +;—Dn 2:33, 2:34 + 11 t. 2; 4:12, 4:20, 5:4, 5:23, 7:7, 7:19.

title: פְּרַס
content: [Str6536–37] † [פְּרַס] vb. break in two (v. BH פרס);—Pe‘îl (WCG224) Pf. 3 fs. פְּרִיסַת מַלְכוּתָח Dn 5:28.

title: פְּרֵס
content:
[Str6537,4484] † פְּרֵס (rd. פְּרָס ? M78 * f.) prob. n.[m.] halfmina (NH פְּרָס, OAram. פרס, פרש Lzb354 SAC99 Cooke176, 406; v. מְנֵא and reff.);—abs. ´פ: Dn 5:28; pl. פַרְסִין(וּ) [read פְּרָסִין ? v. M1. c.] v:25.

[Str6540,6539] † פָּרַס n.pr. terr. et gent. Persia (as kingdom), Persians (v. BH id.);—´פ: Dn 6:9, 6:13, 6:16; פָּרָס 5:28, Ezr 4:24, 6:14.

[Str6543] † [פַּרְסַר] adj. gent. Persian;—emph. פרסיא Kt, פְּרְסָאָה Qr (K§ 61, 6) Dn 6:29 the Persian.

title: פְּרַק
content: [Str6562,6561] † [פְּרַק] vb. tear away, break off (v. BH [פָּרַק]);—Pe. Imv. ms. פְּרֻק Dn 4:24 (cf. Dr), acc of sins + ב instr.

title: פְּרַשׁ
content:
[Str6567–68] † [פְּרַשׁ] vb. make distinct (cf. BH (chiefly late));—Pa. Pt. pass. Ezr 4:18 made distinct (BH Ne 8:8; Targum NH).

[Str6573] † פַּרְשֶׁ֫גֶן n.m.:Ezr 4:23 copy (Targum שַׁנְנָא-, Syr. ܦܪܫܓܢܐ; Aram. loan-word in BH, where also פַּתְשֶׁנֶן id.; loan-word from Pers. (Thes1133; Add.108), cf. Armen. patǧên, copy, GildemeisterZKM iv.210 LagGes. Abh. 79; Armen. Stud. § 1838 MeyEnst. J. 22 HoffmZA ii. 52, OIran. * paticayan, id., acc. to AndrM 79*; not clear whether ´פַּר: is text. err. for ´פּת: (Hoffm: l. c.), or from diff. orig. (Andrl. c. paračayan? paricayan?), or from same √ in diff. stage (so appar. Scheft52, citing, for both, OBaktr. fra-sêṅhana, announcement, OIran. praśaṃsana, praśāsana, command, Ar. frasasti, command, patisêṅhana, answer, OP. *patithaṅhana, announcement, answer));—cstr. ´פ: Ezr 4:11, 4:23, 5:6.

title: פְּשַׁר
content:
[Str6590] † [פְּשַׁר] vb. interpret (a dream) (Targum id., Syr. ܦܫܪ, perh. Eg. Aram. פשר Lzb355 SAC100 (Ar. فسّر loan-word, v. Frä263); As. pašâru);—Pe. Inf. לְמִפְשַׁר Dn 5:16, acc. cogn. פִשְׁרִין Pa. Pt. act. מְפַשַׁר Dn 5:12, acc. חֶלְמִין.

[Str6591,6592] פְּשַׁר:31 n.m.:Dn 2:45 interpretation (of dream) (cf. BH as loan-word);—cstr. ´פ: Dn 4:3, 5:15, 5:26, 7:16; emph. פִּשְׁרָא 2:4 + 7 t. Dn, + 4:15, 4:16 Kt (Qr הֵּ֯); הָ֯ 2:7, 5:12; sf. הֵּ֯ 2:5, 2:6, 2:6 + 11 t. Dn, + Qr 4:15, 4:16 (Kt אָ֯); pl. פִּשְׁרִין 5:16.

[Str6600,6599] † פִּתְגָם n.m.:Ezr 6:11 command, word, affair (Pers.: v.BH);—abs. ´פ: Dn 3:16; emph. מָא- Ezr 4:17 +;—command Ezr 6:11, word, by missive 5:7, from king 4:17 (both c. שְׁלַת), in answer 5:11 (c. התיב); weakened, thing, affair Dn 3:16, 4:14.

title: פְּתַח
content: [Str6605–06] † [פְּתַח] vb. open (v. BH);—Pe. Pt. pass. fpl. פְּתִיחָן Dn 6:11 opened (windows). Pe‘îl (WCG 225) Pf. 3 mpl. פְּתִ֫יחוּ 7:10 books were opened.

title: פתא
content:
[Str6601] פתא (√ of foll.; Targum Syr.; BH פתה (rara)).

[Str6613] † [פְּתָי] n.[m.] breadth (Targum Syr.; Eg. Aram. RES246 S-CD4);—sf. פְּתָיֵהּ Dn 3:1, Ezr 6:3.
